# OpenCV.js

`opencv-5.0.0.js` is the self-contained (embedded WebAssembly) build distributed
by `@techstark/opencv-js@5.0.0-release.1` under Apache-2.0.

- Source: https://github.com/TechStark/opencv-js/tree/v5.0.0-release.1
- Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/@techstark/opencv-js/-/opencv-js-5.0.0-release.1.tgz
- SHA-256: `b873c8211421da7b9bf41ae157a923f05a46a0b8d3e5904c44c6f3ad6d39a1bd`
- License: `opencv-LICENSE.txt`

It is loaded lazily from this site's own origin in a disposable Worker only
when a user selects a photo. It does not receive or upload photos remotely.
